tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Midnight Navy. The brand colour: headlines, the logo tile, dark slides. 15:1 on chalk-50.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Deep Blue. Cards and panels on dark slides; the 'Right way' column. White text on it is 11:1.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Signal Orange. The accent FILL: CTA pills, the logo arrow, progress bars, numerals on dark slides. Text on it is navy-900 (5.8:1), never white (2.9:1). Not a text colour on light grounds.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: Burnt Orange. Accent TEXT on light grounds: emphasised words, numerals, eyebrows. 4.6:1 on chalk-50, 5:1 on white; on sky-100 it is 4.2:1, so only at 24px and up there.

tokens.name: amber-300
tokens.usage: Win Amber. Highlights on dark slides: emphasised words, step labels, the stat number. 10:1 on navy-900, 7:1 on navy-700. Never on light grounds.

tokens.name: chalk-50
tokens.usage: Chalk. The primary slide background — warm off-white, like a whiteboard.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cards on chalk, sky or photos; alternate light slide ground.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Sky Panel. Content panels, the save slide ground, the 'prospect' chat bubble.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy on chalk-50, white and sky-100 (14:1 on chalk).

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, the 'Wrong way' column, small print. 6.9:1 on chalk-50, 6.3:1 on sky-100.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Hairlines, list dividers, the frame around a placeholder. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Default slide ground (about half of every carousel).

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards and overlays on photos.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Panels; the save-worthy slide ground.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Dark slides — the hook scrim, the framework slide, the stat slide. Never two dark slides in a row.

tokens.name: surface-dark-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on a dark slide.

tokens.name: text-headline
tokens.usage: Headlines on chalk-50, white and sky-100.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on light grounds.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and secondary lines on light grounds.

tokens.name: text-emphasis
tokens.usage: One or two emphasised words per headline, numerals and eyebrows on light grounds.

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: All text on surface-dark, surface-dark-raised and under photo-scrim.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Emphasis on dark grounds (words, numbers, labels).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: CTA pills, progress bar, check discs. Text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill (5.8:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, 2px on the 1080px canvas.

tokens.name: photo-scrim
tokens.usage: Navy overlay behind text on full-bleed photos; fade it upward from the text edge so text holds 4.5:1 on any photo.

styles.name: hook-title
styles.sample: Your counsellors aren't losing leads. They're losing the first 5 minutes.
styles.usage: Slide 1 only. 3–4 lines max. One or two words in <em>.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: The headline on every content slide. Max 3 lines.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles inside cards, step names, column heads.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: List and step numbers: text-emphasis on light, highlight on dark.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The one big number on a StatSlide. Only real, sourced numbers.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Here's the 4-step call flow top edtech teams use.
styles.usage: The one supporting line under a headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Speed-to-lead beats a better script. Call within 5 minutes.
styles.usage: Paragraphs and list items. Under 45 words a slide.

styles.name: chat
styles.sample: "The fee is a bit high for us."
styles.usage: Lines inside ScriptSlide bubbles — what the parent says, what you say.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, slide counter, brand name in the header. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to title; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between list rows; card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; headline to body.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between major blocks on a slide.

tokens.name: space-safe
tokens.usage: Outer margin of every 1080 × 1350 slide. Keep headlines inside the centre 1080 × 1080 so the profile-grid crop still reads.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, chips, the photo brief note.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Photo frames inside a slide.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: CTA pills, progress bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Only for a card floating on a photo. Cards on flat grounds have none.

tokens.name: canvas-width
tokens.usage: Instagram 4:5 portrait slide width.

tokens.name: canvas-height
tokens.usage: Instagram 4:5 portrait slide height.

tokens.name: image-min
tokens.usage: Minimum share of an image slide given to the photo.

tokens.name: image-max
tokens.usage: Usual maximum on content slides; the full-bleed hook is the exception.
